responsibility: This source file implements the core AArch64 target builtins outside the SVE-specific framework, covering general architectural builtins and AdvSIMD/NEON builtin registration, typing, folding, and RTL expansion. It defines builtin type qualifiers and mode mappings, creates builtin declarations from the generated builtin tables, provides expansion helpers for SIMD intrinsics and floating-point environment operations, and resolves overloaded non-SVE builtins such as Memory Tagging Extension intrinsics by reconstructing the function type from the call arguments before later target expansion.
